name: lego-games
description: Exact TypeScript ports of classic LEGO PC games, reverse-engineered from the original binaries and run on the player's own game files.

scripts.check: pnpm run verify && pnpm run duplicates && pnpm -r run check
scripts.ci: pnpm run verify && pnpm run duplicates && pnpm -r run ci && pnpm run format:check
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .git-hooks || true
scripts.differential: sh reverse-engineering/emulator/setup.sh && pnpm --filter @lego-games/lego-racers exec vitest run differential
